title: More photo and video formats open
summary: HEIC, TIFF, MKV, AVI, 3GP and more now open in Nest and Glint.

items.title: More photo and video formats open
items.text: iPhone HEIC photos, TIFF scans and videos like MKV, AVI and 3GP now open in Nest and Glint on any browser. Roost makes a viewing copy the first time and keeps it; your original is never changed.
